Datasource.Parameter: (SELECT ST_MakePolygon(way) as way , tags->'seamark:name' AS name FROM planet_osm_line WHERE ST_IsClosed(way) AND tags->'seamark:type' IN ('separation_zone','separation_crossing', 'separation_roundabout') UNION SELECT way , tags->'seamark:name' AS name FROM planet_osm_polygon WHERE tags->'seamark:type' IN ('separation_zone','separation_crossing', 'separation_roundabout') ) AS way
